newsitem.title: USA: US Defense Dept okays small trucker fuel surcharge.
newsitem.headline: US Defense Dept okays small trucker fuel surcharge.

text.p: The U.S. Department of Defense has agreed to a small surcharge for the trucking industry, though it falls well short of compensating for the sharp rise in fuel costs faced by the transport industry in the last few months.

"The country's biggest shipper, the Department of Defense has agreed to take surcharges starting Friday," said Kenneth Simonson, chief economist at the Washington, D.C.-based American Truckers Associations (ATA).
Simonson said the surcharge and others that may follow would likely range between 1.5 and three percent -- not even close to nearly 20 percent rise in fuel costs over last year.
